subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should `board.widget.appView` and persisted revision-bound MCP tool grants become the supported public gateway/dashboard contract for durable pinned MCP apps?
rationale: The implementation adds a new gateway method and durable authorization lifecycle; code review cannot determine the intended permanent API and upgrade policy without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor the durable dashboard contract
options.body: Confirm the RPC and grant lifecycle as the supported design, then require upgrade/security validation and real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep widgets read-only
options.body: Retain dashboard rendering and lease recovery but remove durable app-tool grants if persistent interactive authority is not desired.

options.title: Pause for a narrower API proposal
options.body: Split the protocol and durable-grant direction into a scoped design decision before merging this broad implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable dashboard contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the RPC and grant lifecycle as the supported design, then require upgrade/security validation and real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit series shows this contributor owns the proposed implementation details and can route the product question to the appropriate dashboard/gateway decision-maker.
